title: create andesite steam age
description: a resource pack that change all copper fluid items to andesite
body:
a simple resourcepack that change almost every fluid/steam related create mod (+6.0v) block to make them look made from andesite alloy instead of copper

# it contains:
- fluid tank
- steam engine
- spout
- fluid pipe
- mechanical pump
- hose pulley
- item drain
